description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance metrics across different layers of a model, comparing various token-precision configurations against a baseline. The x-axis represents five distinct layer ranges: Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32, plotted on a linear scale without numerical tick marks. The y-axis represents Relative Change, scaled linearly from -25% to +5%, with major gridlines and tick labels at every 5% interval. Four distinct lines are plotted: a gold line with circle markers representing LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit, which starts near 0%, dips slightly, and ends near 0%; a red line with square markers for LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit, which begins near 0%, dips to approximately -5%, and then rises slightly; a teal line with circle markers for RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit, which starts near 0%, dips to approximately -15% in Layer13-20, and then rises to near 0%; and a dark blue line with square markers for RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit, which starts near -5%, plunges to approximately -25% in Layer13-20, and then rises to approximately -5%. A dashed gray line, labeled Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit, remains nearly flat at 0% across all layer ranges.
